reserves.name: USDC deposited into Ember Earn's Ethereum vault
reserves.issuerOrObligor: Ember Earn vault and Circle USDC

reserveReview.rationale: The 2026-09-21 ERC-4626 observer read separates 0.018665813382% idle USDC from 99.981334186618% deployed Ember Earn strategy positions. Ember's product disclosure identifies eEARN as a USDC-denominated, Ember-managed stablecoin-yield vault using lending, fixed-income, liquidity, and rate-carry strategies. The deployed slice is therefore classified as an Ember protocol position rather than misidentified as direct USDC; its changing constituent positions remain unlinked.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: Ember Earn product disclosure, verified vault contract identity, and live ERC-4626 idle-versus-deployed observer reads
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The observer identifies idle USDC separately from the Ember-managed deployed strategy position. Ember discloses the strategy families but not a current constituent-by-constituent allocation, so the deployed slice remains a reviewed non-link rather than a direct USDC dependency.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: The deployed balance is an identified Ember-managed multi-strategy protocol position; the reviewed sources do not support attributing it to one tracked stablecoin.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The reviewed sources identify the current onchain Ember vault wrapper over USDC but do not establish a legal custody wrapper, bankruptcy remoteness, provider allocation, or a separate assurance report. Liquidity is therefore left unknown rather than inferred from secondary-market trading.
